_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I made a machete in Blender, how do I get it into Madness Project Nexus as a new weapon?
can you write me a harmony patch for project nexus so enemies drop their guns more often
Make a Project Nexus level with a boss room.
expectations: the madnesswright-modtools skill is not invoked (madnesswright-scenes' job)

evals.prompt: Write a Harmony patch for RimWorld that doubles crop yield.
expectations: the madnesswright-modtools skill is not invoked (a different game)

evals.prompt: Write a Harmony mod for Madness Project Nexus that makes reloads twice as fast. My game is installed at the usual Steam path.
expectations: before any [HarmonyPatch] target is written, the agent locates or decompiles Assembly-CSharp.dll (ilspycmd, ILSpy, mcilspy) or states the target is unverified and asks for a decompile
the info.txt it writes has AssemblyPath, HarmonyID and EntryType

evals.prompt: Set up a Project Nexus code mod skeleton in a folder FastReload: the csproj, the entry class and info.txt. Don't guess any game method names.
expectations: FastReload/info.txt parses, has AssemblyPath pointing at the built DLL path, HarmonyID and EntryType Namespace.Class
the entry class implements IModEntrypoint with Initialize() and Unload(), and logs a line with the HarmonyID
the csproj references Assembly-CSharp and 0Harmony from the game's Managed folder with Private false, and the TargetFramework is justified from Managed/ or marked to be checked
no [HarmonyPatch] names a game method as fact; any placeholder is marked as such
